requirements.statement: A checkout accepts whole item quantities from 1 to 5 inclusive. It rejects all other quantities without updating the cart.

integer_constraint.accepted_result: The cart displays the submitted quantity.
integer_constraint.rejected_result: A validation error appears and the existing cart quantity is unchanged.

requirements.statement: A discount from 0 to 20 percent inclusive is saved. A larger or negative discount is rejected without changing the saved discount.

integer_constraint.accepted_result: The saved discount equals the submitted percent.
integer_constraint.rejected_result: A validation error appears and the saved discount is unchanged.

cases.title: Accept a typical quantity
cases.expected: The cart displays the submitted quantity.

cases.title: Reject quantity above the allowed limit
cases.expected: A validation error appears and the existing cart quantity is unchanged.

cases.title: Accept the maximum quantity
cases.expected: The cart displays the submitted quantity.

cases.title: Accept a typical discount percent
cases.expected: The saved discount equals the submitted percent.

cases.title: Reject discount percent above the allowed limit
cases.expected: A validation error appears and the saved discount is unchanged.

cases.title: Accept the maximum discount percent
cases.expected: The saved discount equals the submitted percent.
